snippet.title: Earth Must Die is launching January 27th on Steam! Play the demo NOW!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Earth Must Die & play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639780/Earth_Must_Die/

Earth Must Die is filled with a cast of British celebrities, such as the likes of Joel Fry, Alex Horne & many more! Encounter infuriating characters, progress through the story with witty humour, and try to destroy Earth, we guess? If Vvalak ever ends up getting there...
